Think of it like an oven timer. The system has a built-in rule: "if the setup isn't done in 90 minutes, stop it." Previous sessions finished with a few minutes to spare. | Setting | Value |

```http
PATCH https://<event0-controller-host>/api/v2/job_templates/<template_id>/
Content-Type: application/json

The AAP2 API endpoint for workflow templates is `/api/v2/workflow_job_templates/<id>/`. A platform admin will need to confirm which template ID to patch and whether the timeout is on the WJT or its child job template node.

**Recommended action:** Raise the timeout to **7,200 seconds (120 minutes)** before the next session.
